## HaloBar 0.0.10

### New
- **Many more widgets.** Clocks, weather, money and online services join the gallery, with a search box to find them.
- **A different theme when not on desktop.** The desktop and maximized apps can each have a whole theme of their own. Following Astraeus, each wears the matching one of Astraeus'.
- **The Clear look, and glass tints.** Clear has icons that turn black or white to suit what's behind them, and panels in glass tinted by your wallpaper. Glass can be tinted dark, white or any color.
- **Accessibility.** High contrast, Windows' text size, keyboard navigation and screen reader support, under **Advanced**.
- **Report a problem.** Copies a report with your name taken out. Nothing is sent: read it, then paste it where you choose.
- **Timers of any length.** Type `20` for minutes, `1h 30m`, `90s` or `1:30`.

### Better
- **Type your accent color.** Click the hex code to edit it or paste one in.
- **Sliders** stop with their knob inside the track at both ends.
- **Starts sooner at sign-in**, without waiting in Windows' line of startup apps.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
